recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast asymmetrical composition featuring a stark white left-hand field for bold, stacked typography and a rounded-corner black vertical panel on the right containing two stacked, blue-tinted profile portraits.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between white negative space and dark photographic content
Repetition of profile silhouettes within a singular dark frame
Alignment of text blocks to the left margin of the photographic panel
coreInvariants: Rounded-corner rectangular frame for the image
High-contrast blue rim lighting on subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are positioned in the right third of the frame, stacked vertically within a black pill-shaped container.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, condensed orange and brown text block in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left orange text, moves down through the brown and blue text, then shifts right to the illuminated profiles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left and bottom acts as a structural buffer for the heavy typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange, Earthy Brown, and Cobalt Blue
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white background contrasts with low-value black container; accents are mid-saturation.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed grotesque sans-serif and wide geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical elongation for primary display text
Uniform stroke weight in the condensed faces
Wide, blocky proportions for secondary blue text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Brackets flanking the bottom text block are stylized with sharp, inward-pointing serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-narrow display text paired with wide, blocky subtitle text.
graphicDevices: Small square logo badge in top left corner

preserve: The vertical stacking of the two profiles

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy-weight display style.
Matches the wide, geometric blue text style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a white square canvas. On the right side, place a vertical black panel with rounded corners. Inside the panel, place two male profile portraits stacked vertically, illuminated with strong blue rim lighting against the black background. Leave the left half of the canvas entirely white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed sans-serif text in the top left in orange and brown. Below that, add a block of wide, geometric blue text flanked by thin decorative black brackets.

verificationChecks: Is the photographic panel rounded at the corners?
Is the lighting on the faces strictly blue?
Are there three distinct colors used for the text?
Is the layout asymmetrical with a white left field?

adjustableVariables: Specific accent colors for the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: High-contrast duotone effect in the photo
avoid: Soft or blurry edges on the photographic panel

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the photographic panel
Check that the blue lighting feels like a rim light, not a flat wash
Verify the ultra-condensed font maintains legibility
Confirm the white space feels intentional and balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Asymmetrical split + Rounded-corner dark container + Blue rim-lit profiles + Multi-color condensed typography.
